Parking: Frequently Asked Questions While many treatments are not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding, we do offer safe options to keep your skin healthy and glowing during this special time. Our providers are highly knowledgeable about what’s safe and appropriate and how to treat skin concerns that can occur during pregnancy. We recommend scheduling a complimentary consultation so we can create a personalized treatment plan that’s both safe and effective for you. What treatments are safe while pregnant or breastfeeding? Absolutely! Trying injectables for the first time can feel like a big step, and we’re here to make it easy and comfortable. Our team will walk you through every option, answer all your questions, and create a customized plan that enhances your natural beauty—subtly and safely. Many first-time clients are surprised at how gentle the process is and love the refreshed, natural results. We’ll make sure you feel confident and informed every step of the way. I’m nervous about trying injectables for the first time — can you guide me? Absolutely! We offer a wide range of non-injectable treatments that deliver beautiful, visible results. From advanced facials and laser therapies to skin-tightening and collagen-boosting procedures, our team will create a personalized plan that aligns with your goals and comfort level. There’s always a treatment that meets you where you are in your aesthetic journey. I’m not ready for injections — do you offer other options? A complimentary consultation (in-person or virtual) is always the best first step! Meg & Co. offers a wide range of aesthetic services, and our experienced providers love working one-on-one to design a customized treatment plan that aligns with your goals and comfort level. We take pride in offering honest, thoughtful guidance, never overselling or pressuring. I’m not sure which service is right for me, where should I start?
